football_evidence.question: Can Colorado win at the line of scrimmage?
football_evidence.assessment: No material disagreement: EdgeDesk and the line are within 1.8 points.
supporting: When Oklahoma State has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Oklahoma State’s offense has allowed a sack on 2.3% of its dropbacks, and Colorado’s defense sacks the quarterback on 6.3% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.6%).

When Oklahoma State has the ball (big plays through the air): Oklahoma State’s offense turns 16.5% of its pass plays into explosive gains, and Colorado’s defense gives up explosive gains on 11.4% of opponent pass plays (FBS average 10.3%).

When Colorado has the ball (big plays on the ground): Colorado’s offense turns 5.8% of its runs into explosive gains, and Oklahoma State’s defense gives up explosive gains on 3.2% of opponent runs (FBS average 6.6%).

When Oklahoma State has the ball (the passing game against the pass defense): Oklahoma State’s offense averages 9.7 yards per pass attempt, and Colorado’s defense allows 6.9 yards per pass attempt (FBS average 7.4).
contradicting: In his last two games (Texas Tech and Utah), Wilson averaged 7.3 yards per attempt, against 5.7 in his two games before that.
EdgeDesk’s position-group ratings put Colorado’s secondary No. 80 nationally and Oklahoma State’s No. 118.
EdgeDesk’s position-group ratings put Colorado’s pass defense No. 42 nationally and Oklahoma State’s No. 81.
EdgeDesk’s position-group ratings put Colorado’s defense No. 17 nationally and Oklahoma State’s No. 61.
quarterbacks: Drew Mestemaker has completed 136 of 205 passes (66.3%) for 1,940 yards, 9.5 yards per attempt, 16 touchdowns and 6 interceptions in six games for Oklahoma State, and has been sacked on 5 of 210 dropbacks.
Isaac Wilson has completed 57 of 100 passes (57.0%) for 684 yards, 6.8 yards per attempt, 4 touchdowns and 4 interceptions in four games for Colorado, and has been sacked on 3 of 103 dropbacks.
Julian Lewis has completed 58 of 93 passes (62.4%) for 709 yards, 7.6 yards per attempt, 6 touchdowns and 2 interceptions in four games for Colorado, and has been sacked on 8 of 101 dropbacks.
